description: Detail view for a single member of Congress (or executive-branch filer): full lifetime trade count, windowed activity, late-filing rate, avg days-to-file, estimated disclosed volume, and avg excess return vs SPY across disclosed trades — the closest the public data gets to "this member's trades have been beating the index". Accepts a full name ("Nancy Pelosi"), a last name ("Pelosi"), or a canonical filer id ("house_nancy_pelosi").

days.description: Look-back window in days for windowed stats. Default 365.

member.description: Representative name (last name or full) or canonical filer id.

name: politician_member_activity
title: Politician Member Activity
